$comment: SUPERSEDED by ADR 0024 (docs/project-boards.md): the board's columns are the Stage issue field, Status is aligned with Stage both ways by the reconciler, and the views and workflows change. statusFromLabels, views and workflows below are the old ADR 0007 spec, kept until Configure the Agent work project template once (agent-kit issue 20) rewrites this file and build-project.js. Priority is the org number field 1-100 (100 = do first); there are no priority labels.

views.name: Needs me
views.manual: Sort by Priority descending (100 first), then Waited on me (h) descending.

views.name: Ready for agents
views.manual: Sort by Priority descending (100 first). Blocked issues are excluded: an agent never picks one up.

views.name: Milestone
views.manual: Group by Milestone; sort by Priority descending (100 first).

workflows: Run after the script: it replaces the Status options, so any workflow set earlier loses its value (shown with a red !) and must be re-picked.
Item added to project → Set Status: Inbox (on)
Pull request merged → Set Status: Done (on)
Auto-add to project: this repo, filter is:issue,pr is:open (on)
Auto-close issue (off: closing drives Status, never the other way)
Pull request linked to issue (off: labels drive In progress)
Code changes requested / Code review approved (off)
